clauses.text:
By virtue of the authority vested in me as President by the Constitution of the  
United States of Am erica, and in order to terminate the Presidential Advisory  
Board on Am bassadorial Appointments established on February 5, 1977, it is  
hereby ordered that Executive Order No. 11970, as amended, and Section 1 -  
101(f) of Executive Order No. 12258, as amended, are revoked.
THE W HITE HOUSE,  
M a rc h  17, 1981.
[FR D oc. 8 1 -8 7 9 5 
Filed 3 -1 8 -8 1 ; 4:16 pm] 
Billing cod e 3 1 9 5 -0 1 -M
